notes.title: Introducing the Dark Quest 4
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!!

We are thrilled to announce Dark Quest 4 coming this fall on STEAM.

A while ago we announced the Dark Quest: Board game which eventually became Dark Quest 3. Looking back we feel like we missed an opportunity to create a dungeon crawler that plays on the board in a very similar fashion how you would play tabletop games such as Hero Quest, Descent, Dwarven Saga etc..

We decided to re-visit this idea and we are pleased to reveal the gameplay for Dark Quest 4.

[previewyoutube=LKCmQyN9Idk;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of the big features in the game you should expect to see:
[list]
[*] Campaign with handmade quests
[*] Coop Multiplayer up to 3 people
[*] Steam workshop support for user made quests and campaigns.
[/list]

We are looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback in order to make the best Dark Quest game yet.
Thank you.

WISHLIST NOW!! AND SPREAD THE NEWS!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453840/Dark_Quest_4/
